review:
Fruit Rainbow is a classic fruit machine in a 5x4, 40-line format. Pragmatic Play's description is short: stacked symbols and strong pays, without a complicated feature set.

Stacked symbols are the main source of bigger wins, since a reel covered in one fruit can complete several lines at once. The in-game screens advertise up to 2,000x, a modest ceiling that fits the game's simple style. The RTP of 96.53% is competitive. It's best for players who want quick, uncomplicated spins rather than tumbles, clusters or long bonus rounds.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
